title: Lamda Rockets
description: The &6Lamda-98 Rocket&r is a rocket which can be used to launch satellites for cheaper and faster.

The launch pad consumes &e200kHE/s&r constantly and each launch consumes 16000mb of &bLeaded Gasoline&r and &bHydrogen Peroxide&r. The launches can be set to automatic if fuel and materials are supplied.
